messages:
Leo M: FYI reseller wants a technical validation call + pricing carveout for their CN customers. Main asks: CN tenant, SSO, data residency, and a temporary free trial period for 30 days.
Juniper S: Do we have a CN tenant pattern we can offer as a quick POC (not full private)?
Ravi G: We can spin a Private deployment in partner's region but it requires their infra creds and legal ok for data residency. Otherwise hosted with strict egress controls could work.
Leo M: Partner is pushing for no outbound cross-border egress. They want logs to stay in-region.
Nora Legal: If logs/data must stay in CN, we need a data processing addendum and possibly a local entity agreement. I can draft a clause but need confirmation of retention windows.
Juniper S: From an SSO angle, they prefer OIDC. Do we support OIDC broker to partner IdP for Private?
Olga-Eng: Yes, Private supports OIDC via our proxy. We'll need partner's issuer URL, client_id, and jwks. We also support SAML.
Ravi G: Note on model serving: they asked about quantized FP16 + int8 options to reduce GPU cost. For POC we can point them to the 'small-latency' flavor which is int8-quantized and fits 8GB GPUs.
Leo M: Great — include that in the POC doc. Also they asked for an upper bound on latency p95 for 512 tokens.
Olga-Eng: p95 for 512 tokens on a single 80GB A100 equiv with our batching defaults is ~220ms for int8 model, ~150ms for fp16. I'll include numbers with batch sizes.
Juniper S: Pricing question: they want trial credit equivalent to 50k tokens + waived egress for 30 days. Approve?
Ravi G: We can do a promotional credit but egress waiver needs BizOps sign-off. Maybe cap waived egress to 1TB.
Leo M: @Olga-Eng can you prepare a one-page POC checklist: infra creds, SSO metadata, sample traffic pattern, and a smoke test curl?
Olga-Eng: Yep. Will include a curl example: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.private/model/invoke`
Nora Legal: Also need clarifications for their security questionnaire: Q4 (data residency), Q11 (encryption of keys), Q18 (legal data access). If we intend to store logs in CN, confirm whether Redwood personnel will have access; that's a blocker for them.
Juniper S: Partner wants Redwood engineers to have read-only troubleshooting access for the POC. They said limited-time access OK with audit logs.
Ravi G: We can provision time-limited support access via IAM role and audit keys. We'll require a ticketed request and MFA.
Leo M: Action items: 1) Olga one-pager + latency table. 2) Nora draft DPA + addendum notes for limited access. 3) Juniper produce SSO requirements and sample metadata template. 4) Ravi outline quantization flavors and recommended instance classes + cost delta. 5) Me to push a sample credit proposal to BizOps.
Olga-Eng: I'll aim for the one-pager + curl + network checklist by Thursday EOD.
Nora Legal: DPA draft and access terms by Friday AM.
Juniper S: SSO template and test user steps by Thursday noon.
Ravi G: Cost delta for int8 vs fp16 and instance sizing by Thursday.
Leo M: Partner sync Thursday 3pm CST — I’ll invite everyone. Can we have all deliverables before then?
Olga-Eng: Confirmed.
Nora Legal: If partner insists on no Redwood employee access, we need an exception workflow. Will flag if that happens.
eng-deploy-bot: Tenant provisioning request queued: ticket#P-1129. Estimated lead time 4 business days after creds provided.
Leo M: Thanks team. I'll draft the trial credit email and loop in BizOps for the egress cap. :handshake:
